title: Why Did a Transparent PNG Turn White After JPEG Export?
description: A transparent PNG can turn white when exported as JPEG because JPEG does not retain an alpha transparency channel.
direct: JPEG cannot store a transparent background. If your transparent PNG turned white after export, return to the transparent original and export PNG when you need the background to remain clear.

cards.choice.heading: Preview color is not file evidence
cards.choice.body: A white viewer background does not prove that transparency is gone. Inspect the actual file type and place the image over another color in a tool that supports transparency. White pixels baked into a JPEG differ from transparent pixels displayed over white.
sections.explain.heading: Conversion cannot restore an alpha channel
sections.explain.body: Converting a white-backed JPEG to PNG changes the format, but does not automatically identify and remove the white background. Background removal is a separate editing task; PhotoFix is not claimed as a background-removal tool here.
sections.practice.heading: Match the output to the task
sections.practice.body: Its public listing states that PNG preserves transparency and JPEG replaces it with white. Supported inputs include HEIC, JPEG, PNG and device-compatible RAW up to 60 megapixels. The first three successful photo conversions are free, with each photo in a batch counting separately; more require purchase. Keep the transparent source for future edits. The acetate illustration is a concept, not a measured App export.
faqs.reader-question-1.heading: How can I tell whether the white area is part of the file?
faqs.reader-question-1.body: Place the image over a colored background in an editor that supports transparency. If the area stays white, those pixels are opaque.
faqs.reader-question-2.heading: Will converting the white JPEG back to PNG remove the background?
faqs.reader-question-2.body: No. PNG can preserve transparency that is already present. Removing a solid background requires a separate edit.

steps.step-2.text: Export a separate copy. Preserve the original while checking the saved file type and transparency.
steps.step-3.text: Test the file in the actual design or receiving app over a contrasting background. Share that verified PNG rather than an older JPEG copy.
